qualification.title: Grader qualification
qualification.notice: Qualify this exact published version before training collection or workflow reservation. Controls check declared outcomes; independence, coverage and exposure require an attributable review. Successful controls alone do not establish semantic or visual qualification, model quality or dispatch authority.
qualification.exposureReview: Prior exposure and source exclusions review
qualification.requirementsHint: Array of {id, statement, positiveControls: [control IDs], negativeControls: [control IDs]}. Map every substantive requirement and every control. Native validation checks the complete contract.
qualification.controlsHint: Array of {id, output, expected: pass or fail, rationale}. Provide at least two accepted alternatives and two targeted negative controls with distinct IDs and outputs. Different bytes alone do not prove independent mechanisms.
qualification.invalidPanel: Provide a nonempty requirement array and at least four controls. Native validation checks their contents and coverage.
qualification.immutableRetry: The submitted inputs and request identity are frozen. A failed first panel cannot be replaced; publish a reviewed revision for a new panel. An interrupted one goes on with the same request.
qualification.record: Exact review, controls and first evidence
qualification.unsupported: Qualification requires a published train/held-out version with a supported evaluator. Rubrics also require frozen judge seats.

states.interrupted: First qualification interrupted before any verdict; resume it with the same request

promotion.title: Deployment approval
promotion.notice: Only an explicit rule registered before the first campaign admission can support promotion. The native service validates exact qualified versions, fit, complete comparison evidence and the bounded owned deployment contract.
promotion.researchStart: No deployment rule is registered. Starting now makes this a research-only comparison; its results cannot be approved afterward.
promotion.tooLate: This campaign has no preregistered deployment rule and remains research only. A rule cannot be added after its first admission.
promotion.ruleHint: Explicitly approve independent-group-sign-holm-v1: paired independent-group wins against every fixed worker, aggregate and persona, with Holm correction. Repetitions are not independent samples; independence and representativeness remain review assumptions. No rule values are approved by default.
promotion.gain: Minimum group utility gain (0–1, exclusive one)
promotion.qualificationsHint: Separate IDs by whitespace or commas. Include every frozen training and held-out version, qualified before its earliest measurement or reservation. Revoked, failed or incomplete records are refused.
promotion.scopeHint: Exact scope the native service computed from the frozen workflow cases. Role, permissions, profile, limits, budget recipe and entry shape are immutable; native validation compares every training example and workflow step.
promotion.immutableRetry: This registration request is frozen. Retry uses identical inputs; a saved rule cannot be lowered or replaced.
promotion.ruleEvidence: Exact registered rule, scope and qualification hashes
promotion.activateNotice: Issue a certificate only if the complete native report passes the preregistered rule and all qualification bindings remain valid. This enables selection only for the exact opted-in owned scope.
promotion.dispatchNotice: Native dispatch rechecks qualification revocations, context, runtime and account availability. A certificate does not qualify ordinary interactive history, semantic or visual panels, or every work class.
promotion.fallback: Frozen prior/fallback order: {{keys}} · minimum predicted quality: {{quality}}. Explicit model pins remain binding.
promotion.certificate: Certificate evidence, assessment, scope and limits
promotion.trajectoryScope: The rule covers this exact {{count}}-step trajectory with a {{seconds}} s root budget, because its steps do not all share one contract or each step class has its own model. Each step is checked against the model fitted for its own class.
promotion.trajectoryCertificate: This certificate covers only its exact {{count}}-step trajectory. Each step uses the model fitted for its own class; a single task or a different step sequence keeps its prior.

Each new fit or new set of held-out results is one journaled look; a passing look certifies the category. It makes no model calls.
